crossRefs.note: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has…
One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.
When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by…
He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in Yahweh’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods, and…
A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
translations.bsb: His father recognized it and said, “It is my son’s robe! A vicious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces!”
translations.kjv: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
translations.asv: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat: an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.
